reasoning: Both models correctly identified the PKGBUILD as safe: it uses versioned GitHub releases with verified checksums, contains no dangerous commands or hooks, and only installs binaries/license files. The COPYING file is harmless license text. No install scripts or risky files exist.
coverage_issues: Both models skipped auditing the prebuilt binary (src/llm-leaders) and tarball. While expected for bin packages, this leaves payload unverified.
false_negatives: Potential binary payload risk: Neither model flagged the inherent risk of unaudited prebuilt binaries, though this is beyond standard packaging audit scope.
learnings: Prioritize executable/hook files over licenses: Models wasted resources auditing COPYING while no .install/hooks existed.
Improve binary handling: Add warnings about unaudited payloads in bin packages to final reports.
Optimize file selection: Skip static licenses when build/install scripts exist.
